description: MCP authoring tools (document_editor_create/import/export). Create an empty document with one addressable paragraph; import markdown/HTML (text) or DOCX/ODT (base64) into a new document or as a content replacement of an existing one (optimistic concurrency); export to markdown/html text or docx/odt base64 packages — the agent's verification channel. Reuses DocumentMarkdownImporter/DocumentHtmlImporter/DocumentDocxImporter/DocumentOdtImporter and the matching exporters from Tempo.Blazor.DocumentFormats.
